# Que La Femme

> Que La Femme is a discreet home-management studio based in downtown Toronto, serving
> the Greater Toronto Area. Founded by Melissa Kalef. Work is by appointment.
> The name is a play on the founder's name — said aloud, "Que La Femme" sounds like "Kalef, M."

## Services
- Estate Sales (flagship): full, discreet management of an estate sale — private consultation, appraisal and valuation, staging and presentation, running the sale, and auction/consignment liaison.
- Estate Management: sorting, cataloguing and keepsakes, downsizing and relocation, donation and clear-out, and coordination and oversight.
- Home Maintenance Services: house cleaning, minor household repairs, gardens and seasonal clean-ups, painting, small-space design, and moves.
- Home Organization: closets, pantries and kitchens, decluttering and lasting systems, paper and storage solutions.
- Bookkeeping: monthly bookkeeping, invoicing and expense tracking, reconciliations and reporting, tax-season preparation.

## Service area
Downtown Toronto and the Greater Toronto Area, including Yorkville, the Annex, King West,
Leslieville, the Beaches, Leaside, East York, North York, Etobicoke, Scarborough,
Mississauga, Vaughan, and Markham.
